sqlMap.select: SELECT DT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS BANFN, DT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS BNFPO, DT.PO_NO AS SUBNO, DT.PO_SEQ AS SUBIT, NULL AS ODEST FROM ICOMPOHD HD, ICOMPODT DT WHERE HD.BUYER = 'KRLS-A0001' AND HD.BUYER = DT.BUYER AND HD.STATUS != 'D' AND HD.PO_NO = DT.PO_NO AND TRIM(HD.SEND_DATE) IS NULL
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMPOHD SET SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS') WHERE BUYER = 'KRLS-A0001' AND PO_NO = #SUBNO#
